# scenario playback_batch: what the core told the UI, and where it ended up.
# Recorded from internal/irc + internal/state. Regenerate with
# `go test ./internal/transcript -update`, and read doc.go before you do.

stream registration
	conn "connecting"
	conn "ready"
	conn "registering"
	rail
	self <eco>
	status server "- irc.test Message of the Day -"
	status server "- testsrv, a scripted fake server"
	status server "Connected! You are eco"
	status server "End of /MOTD command."
	status server "This server was created at the beginning of the test"
	status server "Welcome to the TestNet IRC Network eco"
	status server "Your host is irc.test, running version testsrv-1"

stream 0 C: join #eco

stream 2 S: :eco!eco@test JOIN #eco / :irc.test 332 eco #eco :topic / :irc.test 353 eco = #eco :@alice eco / :irc.test 366 eco #eco :End of /NAMES list.
	members #eco "alice(@),eco"
	rail
	status #eco "You joined #eco"
	topic #eco "topic"

stream 5 S: @%LABEL% :irc.test BATCH +hist chathistory #eco / @batch=hist;msgid=h1;time=2024-03-01T11:00:00.000Z :alice!alice@test PRIVMSG #eco :old one / @batch=hist;msgid=h2;time=2024-03-01T11:01:00.000Z :bob!bob@test PRIVMSG #eco :old two mentioning eco / @batch=hist;msgid=h3;time=2024-03-01T11:02:00.000Z :dave!dave@test JOIN #eco / @batch=hist;msgid=h4;time=2024-03-01T11:03:00.000Z :eco!eco@test JOIN #eco / :irc.test BATCH -hist
	history #eco "latest"
	msg #eco <alice> [playback] "old one"
	msg #eco <bob> [playback] "old two mentioning eco"
	status #eco "dave joined"

stream 6 S: :irc.test BATCH +hist2 chathistory #eco / @batch=hist2;msgid=h1;time=2024-03-01T11:00:00.000Z :alice!alice@test PRIVMSG #eco :old one / :irc.test BATCH -hist2
	history #eco "latest"

state #eco topic="topic" modes="" key="" members=[alice(@) eco]
	status #eco "You joined #eco"
	msg #eco <alice> [playback] "old one"
	msg #eco <bob> [playback] "old two mentioning eco"
	status #eco "dave joined"

state server topic="" modes="" key="" members=[]
	status server "Welcome to the TestNet IRC Network eco"
	status server "Your host is irc.test, running version testsrv-1"
	status server "This server was created at the beginning of the test"
	status server "- irc.test Message of the Day -"
	status server "- testsrv, a scripted fake server"
	status server "End of /MOTD command."
	status server "Connected! You are eco"
